common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You're offline. Changes will sync when you're back online.

onboarding.languageHint: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Write down who lent what, let the other person confirm it, and never argue about it again.
onboarding.point1: Record a loan in a few seconds
onboarding.point2: The other person confirms with one tap, no app needed
onboarding.noMoneyMoves: {{appName}} never moves money. It only keeps a shared, friendly record.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your phone number or email. No password needed.
auth.phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +98 or +1.
auth.codeSentEmail: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this phone, or type the code from the email.
auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.changeContact: Use a different number or email
auth.invalidPhone: That number doesn't look right. Please include your country code.
auth.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
auth.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Please check it and try again.
auth.privacyNote: Your phone number is only ever shown to the people you share a record with.

profile.title: Profile
profile.setupBody: Your name is shown to the people you share records with.
profile.photoPermission: Please allow photo access in your phone's settings to add a picture.
profile.signOutConfirm: Sign out of {{appName}} on this phone?

settings.title: Settings
settings.irrAsTomanHint: 1 toman = 10 rial. Amounts are saved in rial.
settings.restartBody: The app will restart to switch the text direction.
settings.notificationsBlocked: Turned off in the phone settings. Tap to open them.
settings.deleteBody: Your profile, the records you wrote and their photos will be deleted for good. Records other people wrote stay with them, without your name linked. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: Could not delete your account. Please check your connection and try again.

dashboard.emptyBody: When you lend or borrow money, add it here. The other person gets a link to confirm it.

loans.name: Their name
loans.phoneHint: Optional. Include the country code, for example +98.
loans.reconfirmWarning: {{name}} already confirmed this. If you change the amount, dates, note or photo, they'll be asked to confirm again.
loans.cancelBody: It stays in the history for both of you, but no longer counts.
loans.historyOffline: Connect to the internet to see the full history.
loans.emptyClosed: Settled and cancelled records will appear here.
loans.contactsPermission: Please allow access to contacts in your phone's settings, or type the name.

statusHint.confirmed: You both agree on this record.
statusHint.cancelled: This record was cancelled and no longer counts.

history.name: Name changed to {{to}}
history.joined: Linked to the other person's account

errors.amountInvalid: Please enter an amount, like 50 or 12.50.
errors.phoneInvalid: That number doesn't look right. Please include the country code.
errors.dueBeforeLoan: The pay-back date can't be before the loan date.
errors.noteTooLong: Please keep the note under 500 characters.
errors.crashBody: Your records are safe. Please try again.

sync.pending: Some changes are waiting to be sent.
sync.rejected: A change couldn't be saved because the record had changed. You're seeing the latest version.
sync.signOutPending: Some changes haven't been sent yet. If you sign out now, they'll be lost.

web.title: Please check this record
web.lentYou: {{name}} wrote down that they lent you {{amount}}.
web.borrowedFromYou: {{name}} wrote down that they borrowed {{amount}} from you.
web.photoAttached: A receipt photo is attached in the app.
web.question: Is this right?
web.noAccount: You don't need an account or the app to answer.
web.confirmedBody: {{name}} will see that you confirmed. Nobody has to remember it now.
web.disputedBody: {{name}} will see your comment and can correct the record.
web.alreadyDisputed: You said: “{{comment}}”. If it's been fixed, you can confirm it now.
web.closedConfirmed: This record has already been confirmed. Thank you!
web.closedOther: This link is no longer active.
web.notFound: This link isn't valid. Please ask for a new one.
web.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
web.changed: {{name}} just changed this record. Please have another look.
web.installTitle: Keep track of your own loans
web.installBody: {{appName}} is free. Write down who lent what, and never argue about it again.
web.openInApp: I have the app: open it there
web.privacy: {{appName}} never moves money. This page only records your answer.
web.repaymentQuestion: {{name}} says they paid you back {{amount}} on {{date}}. Did you get it?

share.messageBorrowed: Hi {{name}}! I noted in {{appName}} that I borrowed {{amount}} from you on {{date}}. Could you check and confirm it? {{url}}
share.hint: They can confirm with one tap, no app needed.
share.notReady: The link will be ready as soon as this record reaches the server.

answer.title: {{name}} asks you to confirm this record

claim.adding: Adding this record to your account…
claim.failed: This record couldn't be added. It may already belong to someone else.

repayments.amountBorrower: How much did you pay back?
repayments.amountLender: How much did you get back?
repayments.needsYou: {{name}} says they paid you back {{amount}}. Did you get it?

repayments.borrowerNote: {{name}} will be asked to confirm it.
repayments.tooMuch: That's more than what's still open ({{amount}}).

reminders.sentPush: Reminder sent. {{name}} will get a notification.
reminders.tooSoon: To keep things friendly, reminders are limited to one every two days. You can send the next one on {{when}}.
reminders.autoLabel: Remind them on the pay-back date
reminders.autoHint: A gentle reminder is sent on that day.
reminders.needsOnline: Please connect to the internet to send a reminder.

push.loan_confirmedBody: {{amount}} is now confirmed by both of you.
push.repayment_newBody: {{name}} says they paid back {{repayment}}. Please confirm.
push.settledBody: {{amount}} is fully paid back. Thank you!
